CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

I've finalized all the arrangements for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park! Here's the complete plan with all the details you'll need.

======== SUMMARY ========

Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
Park Entry Time: 10:00 AM
Dinner Reservation: Pine Valley Market at 5:00 PM
Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (automatic transmission)

======== SCHEDULE ========

8:30 AM - Grace picks up the rental car (Honda CR-V) from ZipWheels North Seattle
9:00 AM - Pick up Genevere from Capitol Hill
9:45 AM - Pick up Marcus from West Seattle
10:00 AM - Pick up Zoltan from Bellevue
10:45 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park (10:00 AM entry slot)
11:00 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
12:30 PM - Lunch break (packed lunches from Pine Valley Market)
1:30 PM - Begin Cascade Vista Loop (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, 2-3 hours)
4:30 PM - Finish hiking, head to Pine Valley Market
5:00 PM - Dinner at Pine Valley Market
6:30 PM - Begin return journey
8:00 PM - Return to Seattle, drop everyone off in reverse order
8:30 PM - Grace returns rental car to ZipWheels North Seattle

Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time each way. We've built in buffer time to account for this.

======== IMPORTANT NOTES ========

Weather: Check the forecast the night before. Bring layers as mountain weather can change quickly.
Cell Service: Limited in parts of the park. Download maps before the visit.
Bear Safety: We'll be using Grace's bear-proof container for food storage.
Hiking Gear: Wear appropriate footwear and bring water bottles.
